# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a dark-eyed young woman who was nicknamed the "rose-red" girl. She was voted the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at Regent's Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel has a heart brimming with light, multicolored dreams and imaginations. Despite her romantic nature, she is practical enough to complain about the exhausting realities of teaching a nine-grade country schoolhouse. She intensely dislikes boarding and values pleasant, autonomous living with close friends.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_

## Traits

- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- dreamy  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- dislikes boarding  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012)</sub>

## Abilities

- teaching multiple grades  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- attend college at Wexcombe as a Sophomore  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- rent a small home in Portmaris with friends and keep house with Aunt Euphemia  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- write a realistic paper titled 'The Trials of a Country Schoolmarm'  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## History

Mabel studied at Regent's Academy, where she formed a close friendship with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis and was recognized as the beauty of the Second Year class. After completing her third year at Regent's, she spent two years teaching at an isolated rural schoolhouse with nine grades, dealing with demanding parents and scholars ranging from four to twenty years old. Weary of country teaching and living in boardings, she wrote to Nell proposing that she, Nell, and Honora pool their resources to lease a furnished house in Portmaris for their upcoming studies at Wexcombe College. She arranged for her lonely aunt, Aunt Euphemia, to move to Portmaris and serve as their housekeeper. Later, while sharing the house, Mabel lived alongside her friends and their pets, despairing over the frequent fighting between her cat Smudge and Aunt Euphemia's cat Joseph.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c9 P14](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0014), [v3 c16 P60](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0060), [v3 c16 P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063), [v3 c16 P70](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0070)_

> However, Nell dear, I intend to abandon it, and attend college the coming year. Since I completed the third year at Regent’s, I am eligible to join the Sophomore class.  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
